name: print-social-peach-and-lime-wellness-flyer-template
title: Peach and Lime Wellness Flyer Template
whatItIs: A square flyer template presented on chartreuse: a peach sheet with two rounded food-still-life photos on the left, a large coral headline 'What Wellness Brings to the Table', a black subhead, body copy, contact icons and a lime pill call-to-action.
whatItMeans: Peach, coral and lime feel appetising and healthy, and the moody dark-red photo backgrounds add sophistication.
techniques: Two stacked rounded photos as a left column
Coral heading in heavy sans against a peach ground
Vertical lime slider line as a decorative detail
Lime pill CTA at the base
Template shown on a contrasting chartreuse background

vocabulary.definition: A layout shown on a contrasting field for marketplace listings.
Images stacked vertically beside the text.
A rounded button-shaped call to action.
